caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly rounded shoulder leading up to a short neck that flares outward. The rim of the jar is broad and uneven, with a visible chip on the upper edge. The color of the jar is predominantly brown, with darker and lighter areas indicating shading and texture. There are subtle variations and spots on the surface, giving the jar an aged, worn appearance. The base of the jar is lighter, almost beige or cream-colored, and there are some irregular drip-like marks along the lower portion. No additional objects or decorations are present in the drawing, and the focus is solely on the jar itself. The artist’s signature, “Paul Poffenbarger,” is located near the bottom right of the image.
title: Fruit Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
